about: Few-shot examples for the context judgement, sent as earlier user/assistant turns. Invented company (Orbitly), codenames and customers that are not in the Macrohard dataset pools. `document` carries the <sN> markers already; each example is rendered with user.md like a real request.

unreleased-roadmap.name: Unreleased roadmap
unreleased-roadmap.description: Plans, launch dates and codenames for products or features that are not public yet.

revenue-figures.name: Revenue figures
revenue-figures.description: Non-public revenue, bookings, margins or growth numbers.

internal-metrics.name: Internal metrics
internal-metrics.description: Non-public usage, adoption, churn or performance metrics.

examples.document:

Following its June 2025 launch, <s1>Project Marigold</s1> is now available on every plan. Teams using it close their books <s2>40%</s2> faster, according to a public customer survey.
